UTIF.js 3.1.0 (npm "utif", https://github.com/photopea/UTIF.js), file UTIF.js unmodified.
pako_inflate.min.js is pako 1.0.11 (https://github.com/nodeca/pako), loaded first so UTIF can inflate Deflate-compressed TIFFs.

Note: the minified JPEG decoder inside UTIF.js (used only for JPEG-compressed TIFFs) appears to be derived from Mozilla pdf.js (jpg.js, Apache License 2.0). UTIF.js ships it under its MIT license without a separate notice; the Apache-2.0 text is in /vendor/pdfjs/LICENSE.
